metadata.title: Research progress of quality control for the seed of Ziziphus jujuba var. spinosa (Bunge) Hu ex H.F. Chow (Suan-Zao-Ren) and its proprietary Chinese medicines

publisher_indexed_crosscheck.caution: Indexed result can concatenate article body and recommended/citing articles; only this DOI/title bibliographic block and its own Abstract Results were used. Unrelated2025 pharmacopoeia/recommended-article passages were not attributed to this2023 review.

short_attributed_abstract_quote: The jujuboside A, jujuboside B, and spinosin were revealed as the key Q-markers for SZS.
